welcomeDescription: Tucked just beyond the bustle of downtown St. John’s, Peter Easton Pub stands as a living piece of Newfoundland’s social fabric—unpolished, unapologetic, and unmistakably authentic.
aboutContent: Named after the infamous 17th-century pirate Peter Easton, the pub carries a fitting sense of rebellious charm. Like its namesake, it feels a little outside the rules—less polished than the bars of George Street, but far richer in character. It’s a place where philosophy students debate in the corner, comedians test new material midweek, and musicians turn ordinary nights into something memorable.
